name: fg-hudless-tracked
why: EXP-0179: submit barriers only for the actual display resource selected by engine-owned RT -> PRESENT evidence at or after the pre-UI cut. Never use the GetBuffer COPY_DEST fake buffer, never CopyResource, and never publish a hudless Frame.
requires: \[fg\] hudless: tracked-barrier split=\d+/\d+ resource=0x[0-9a-f]+ listIndex=\d+ before=0x4 after=0x0\b
\[fg\] streamline: DLSS_G state frame=\d+ result=0 mode=0\b
